Subject: PO / EDI field mapping & portal enrollment

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to start vendor onboarding for Redwood into our procurement systems (primary flow: Coupa, fallback Ariba). Procurement has a few questions up front so our integration team can validate orders and EDI acknowledgements:

- Can you confirm the PO acknowledgement (POACK) and invoice EDI segments you support (we use 850/855/810).
- Our PO schema includes a custom remittance_id and an originator_code field — attached is our current PO_FieldSpec_v2.xlsx. Can your EDI team map these to your invoicing?
- We need a signed Order Form + MSA redline before tech access to the portal is granted. Procurement will not open vendor records without a completed order form and vendor profile.

Attached: PO_FieldSpec_v2.xlsx (field spec)

Next steps from our side: once we have a redlined Order Form + confirmation on field mapping, procurement will create the supplier record and provide a portal admin account for test POs.

Can you send the redlined Order Form and indicate expected SLAs for PO processing?

Thanks,
Anna DuBois
Vendor Onboarding Lead | HealthEdge
anna.dubois@healthedge.com

Hi Anna —

Appreciate the clear field spec. I've attached a redlined Order Form for your review (HealthEdge_OrderForm_redline.docx) and a proposed PO field mapping (PO_Field_Mapping.xlsx) from our billing/ops team. Key notes up-front:

- EDI: We support 850/855/810 and can map custom remittance_id to our remittance_reference field; originator_code can be mapped to invoice_origin if you provide the code list. We will run a test 850/855 flow once the supplier record is provisioned.
- SLA: for Hosted API customers we publish typical processing times (tokenized call latency); for PO ingestion -> invoice generation we expect same-day processing for <100 POs/day and next-business-day for larger volumes unless you opt into a Dedicated queue. I'll flag this as an operational SOW item, not contractual SLA in the Order Form.
- Order Form redlines: I flagged payment terms, vendor contact data, and the "vendor onboarding" appendix for clarity. Ben, could you please confirm the indemnity and limitation of liability redlines? Laura, ops: any gaps in the mapping?

Proposed next steps:
1) Legal accepts or counters Order Form redlines (Ben) — target EOD Friday 4/23.
2) Procurement (HealthEdge) provisions supplier record and portal admin account.
3) Ops run test 850/855 exchange and confirm PO -> invoice mapping.

Attachments: HealthEdge_OrderForm_redline.docx, PO_Field_Mapping.xlsx

Marissa Cole

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Anna DuBois <anna.dubois@healthedge.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PO / EDI field mapping & portal enrollment

Marissa / Team —

I reviewed the redlined Order Form. High-level legal guidance below (I added inline comments in HealthEdge_OrderForm_redline.docx):

- Indemnity / Liability: counter their broad indemnity. Propose a reciprocal indemnity limited to third-party IP claims and a liability cap equal to the greater of $1,000,000 or 12 months of fees.
- Data retention / access: carve out telemetry and usage logs for debugging; require that any production data access for support be logged and limited to scoped incident response. Add SOC 2 Type II attestation reference in the security appendix.
- Termination for convenience: change to 60 days notice (they requested 30).
- PO/Invoice flow: do not accept downstream acceptance language that converts "PO" into a blanket acceptance of services — preserve our change-order and scope confirmation flow in the Order Form appendix.

Operational notes (Laura): Ben asked to confirm that Originator_code -> invoice_origin mapping will be validated in test phase and that remittance_reference flows to our AR system as expected. If test fails, we should enumerate fallback fields (e.g., invoice_notes) before asking procurement for schema changes.

I'll circle back with a clean mark to send to HealthEdge by EOD Friday if there are no additional comments.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: HealthEdge_OrderForm_redline.docx (inline comments)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement_ops@healthedge.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO / EDI field mapping & portal enrollment

Hi Anna —

Thanks — going to summarize next steps and timeline so we stay aligned:

1) Legal redline summary: Ben has proposed reciprocal indemnity language, a liability cap (greater of $1M or 12 months fees), SOC 2 attestation reference, and 60-day termination for convenience. He will provide a clean Order Form to send over by EOD Friday 4/23.

2) Vendor record & portal access: once HealthEdge confirms the supplier record creation we will need a portal admin account for Redwood to run test POs (please add marissa.cole@redwood.com and ops@redwood.com).

3) EDI test plan: Ops will validate mapping for remittance_id -> remittance_reference and originator_code -> invoice_origin during the test. If any field fails mapping we will use invoice_notes as fallback and surface a short change request.

4) Proposed dates: supplier record + admin account by Tue 4/27; test POs Wed 4/28; sign-off on mapping no later than Fri 4/30. Are those dates acceptable?

Attached final items for your intake team: HealthEdge_OrderForm_redline.docx (ben's inline comments) and PO_Field_Mapping.xlsx (ops mapping).

Let me know if procurement needs any additional documentation (W9/Tax, bank remit instructions) to create the vendor.

Looking forward to the test run — we want to make this as low-friction as possible.

Best,
